source: curated (not part of the EUROMOD export)
note: Parameters EUROMOD defines inside functions rather than as named constants, so extracted_parameters/enriched/FR.enriched.json cannot carry them. Ingest with `nomoscope-workflow ingest-params extracted_parameters/curated/FR.in_function.json`; temporal_basis comes from curation/FR.curation.yaml as for every other parameter.

description.fr: Taux de la contribution différentielle sur les hauts revenus.
description.en: Rate of the differential contribution on high incomes.

explanation.en: Defined inside EUROMOD's tinto01_fr Elig function, not as a def_const, so the connector cannot export it; the model_target is the identifier this project has used for it since the first FR runs. Curated here so the parameter store stays the single source — no runtime input is read from a loose file.
